newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade light at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade light at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,000 slaughter steers and 200 heifers; 82,500 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,900 formulated and 1,000 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 63.00.
Wk to date - 82,500 Week Ago - 92,200 Year Ago - 87,300
